statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations
The patient has a history of atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The service was ordered to correlate symptomatic episodes with underlying arrhythmias
The service was ordered to assess the efficacy of current rate-control management
The claim was denied with denial reason code CO-50
The service was not deemed medically necessary under current coverage guidelines
